purpose: Exploratory public digital, scientific and physical-event information channels with independent clocks.

candidates.name: Package-download shock × software issuer exposure
candidates.next_gate: historical coverage, bot/CI contamination audit, package-to-issuer mapping
candidates.hypothesis: Changes in public package-download activity may create a technology-adoption information state for exposed software issuers.
candidates.construction: Use fixed daily PyPI download states from the available historical source and a frozen package-to-issuer map; quantify and fail closed on bot/CI/mirror contamination rather than filtering with return-based criteria.

candidates.name: Scientific-publication burst × R&D exposure
candidates.next_gate: deposit/publication timing, author-affiliation mapping, backward-only information boundary
candidates.hypothesis: A burst in public scientific output may capture innovation intensity around a fixed issuer R&D exposure map.
candidates.construction: Use fixed Crossref/OpenAlex publication/deposit events and predeclared author-affiliation or funding mapping; publication date and deposit/index timestamps remain distinct and later deposits cannot alter earlier states.

candidates.name: Seismic shock × geographic industrial exposure
candidates.next_gate: event origin/publication timing and fixed facility/geography map
candidates.hypothesis: An unusual seismic event may create an operational information state for geographically exposed issuers.
candidates.construction: Combine fixed USGS event states with a frozen facility/geography map; event origin time is not substituted for the earliest proven public observation boundary or next-session availability.

candidates.name: Space-weather shock × operationally sensitive sector
candidates.next_gate: alert issue time, revision/cancellation handling, fixed exposure map
candidates.hypothesis: Public space-weather alerts and warnings may create an operational information state for exposed sectors.
candidates.construction: Use fixed NOAA SWPC alert states keyed to issue time, with corrections/cancellations becoming effective only when publicly issued and exposure taxonomy frozen independently of future returns.

candidates.name: Wildfire/thermal anomaly × geographic industrial exposure
candidates.next_gate: NRT-to-science-quality revision boundary and fixed geography map
candidates.hypothesis: Near-real-time wildfire or thermal anomalies may create a geographic operational-shock state for exposed issuers.
candidates.construction: Use fixed NASA FIRMS observations with a pre-frozen geography map; initial public availability and later science-quality revisions are separate and later replacements cannot backfill earlier states.
